description: A wooden trough that holds working paste at the bench. Any cross bar for wiping the brush is best swapped for a twisted cord, and the tub is cleaned of dried scraps by soaking it overnight with water.
name: paste tub

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter XX, p.280. Internet Archive.
